items.name: mostra-questionnaire
items.title: Questionnaire
items.description: Questions people answer, each answer a field: choices, scales, rankings, text, comments, sections and progress.

items.name: mostra-layout
items.title: Page layout
items.description: The page's frame in its theme: the page with its title, its sections and a row of figures.

items.name: mostra-review
items.title: Review set
items.description: Candidates to compare, comment on and choose between: a gallery, one at a time, or two to four side by side with their difference.

items.name: mostra-page-context
items.title: Inside a page
items.description: Whether a part sits inside the kit's Page, so a questionnaire there titles itself as a section.

items.name: mostra-tokens
items.title: Theme tokens
items.description: The page's theme as values a canvas or WebGL library can take: every colour resolved, the faces and the radius, kept current as the theme or its light or dark changes.

items.name: mostra-live-chart
items.title: Live chart
items.description: A chart of points that keep arriving, many a second, from a live source in append mode or from the page: uPlot on a canvas in the theme's series colours.

items.name: mostra-charts
items.title: Charts
items.description: Bar, line, area and donut charts on Recharts in the theme's series colours, every series named in a legend.

items.name: mostra-echarts
items.title: ECharts
items.description: Any ECharts chart (heat maps, Sankey, treemaps, candlesticks, graphs) from its option, in a theme made from the page's tokens.

items.name: mostra-data-table
items.title: Data table
items.description: A table of rows on TanStack Table, sortable by every column, with a search and pages when asked.

items.name: mostra-mermaid
items.title: Mermaid diagram
items.description: A diagram written as Mermaid text (flowcharts, sequences, states, Gantt charts), drawn in the page's theme.

items.name: mostra-flow
items.title: Flow graph
items.description: Nodes and edges on React Flow's pannable canvas, the nodes the theme's cards and the edges its rules.

items.name: mostra-code
items.title: Code
items.description: Code highlighted by Shiki, and a CodeMirror editor whose text saves as a field, both coloured from the theme.

items.name: mostra-math
items.title: Formula
items.description: TeX typeset by KaTeX, inline in a sentence or on its own line.

items.name: mostra-map
items.title: Map
items.description: A map on MapLibre with deck.gl layers and markers, on a world outline in the theme that needs no tile server.

items.name: mostra-scene
items.title: 3D scene
items.description: A three.js scene on react-three-fiber with light, orbit controls and a floor grid in the theme.

items.name: mostra-whiteboard
items.title: Whiteboard
items.description: An Excalidraw whiteboard whose drawing saves as a field.

items.name: mostra-team
items.title: Team
items.description: Who is here, their cursors, who has answered and who changed a shared field, from the team hooks.
